verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents LLM-based structured extraction as an alternative to CSS/XPath selectors. Its CLI shows a natural-language query flag (-q "Extract all product prices"), so the core of the story is delivered by the product itself. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the natural-language instruction parameter in the Python API and how it pairs with schemas, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from a page using natural language instructions instead of writing selectors

citations.quote: Parse repeated patterns with CSS, XPath, or LLM-based extraction.
LLM-Driven Extraction: Supports all LLMs (open-source and proprietary) for structured data extraction.
Schema Definition: Define custom schemas for extracting structured JSON from repetitive patterns.
